svg.text: Measure actual hardware — schematic diagrams, NOT scale templates. Record mm in checklist.csv.
SERVO: top and side (measure both units)
S1 length
S1 width; S2 shaft center to each case edge
S1 height
S4 boss/spline
S5 ears; S6 installed horn stack; S8 cable
STAR HORN: trace both sides and every hole
H1 arms; H2 tip radius + width
H3 hub OD, raised faces, web thickness
H4 spline engagement + center screw
H5 trace all original holes
Circle is tip envelope, not a horn profile.
CAMERA: actual four-hole mounting face
C2 Px
C2 Py
C3 hole diameters, board thickness, edge offsets, diagonals
Hole positions drawn schematically; no pitch is assumed.
CAMERA SIDE
C4 lens diameter/projection; C5 lens center offsets
C1 full envelope and C6 component keep-outs
C2/C3 all four holes required before screw-mount design
C7 mass, center of mass, cable and IR/light paths
